source_text:
Annual Report 2023

The board of directors presents the audited consolidated results of the Group for the year ended 31 December 2023, together with the comparative figures for 2022, prepared under IFRS (国际财务报告准则) as issued by the International Accounting Standards Board.

Unless otherwise stated, all amounts are presented in Renminbi. Revenue (营业收入) is recognised when control of the promised goods or services is transferred to the customer. EBITDA (息税折旧摊销前利润) is a non-IFRS measure defined in note 3.

[IMAGE]

This document is a translation sample used for pipeline demonstration purposes only.
